input: Find overnight, sleepaway and residential summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near upstate South Carolina near the NC line (Travelers Rest, Cleveland, Marietta, Landrum, Greer, Greenville and Spartanburg). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: overnight summer camp 2026 Greenville Greer Spartanburg kids
Brown Girls Read summer camp 2026 Converse

candidates.name: YMCA of Greenville — Camp Greenville
candidates.note: Rising K–12 overnight programs include traditional camp, adventure trips and leadership development; 2027 dates announced.

candidates.name: Asbury Hills Camp and Retreat Center
candidates.note: Overnight Christian camps for ages 7–17, with traditional and outdoor-adventure tracks; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Look Up Christian Ministries — Look Up Lodge
candidates.note: Three-night kids camps and four- or five-night teen camps for church groups; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Blue Ridge Council, Scouting America
candidates.note: Camp Old Indian offers weeklong Scout summer camps with outdoor activities and merit-badge programs; 2027 guide posted.

candidates.name: Girl Scouts of South Carolina—Mountains to Midlands
candidates.note: Camp WaBak offers overnight programs for girls entering grades 1–12, including traditional, equestrian and leadership sessions.

candidates.name: Greenville County Parks, Recreation & Tourism
candidates.note: Camp Spearhead offers eight weeklong residential sessions for campers with disabilities, ages 8 and older.

candidates.name: Jett Foundation
candidates.note: Camp Promise–Southeast ran August 12–15, 2026, for ages 13+ with muscular dystrophy or selected neuromuscular diseases.

candidates.name: Awanita Valley
candidates.note: Christian camp and retreat center serving youth groups; hosted residential student summer camps in 2026.

candidates.name: Prisma Health Children's Services
candidates.note: Camp Courage provides medically supported weeklong overnight camps for ages 6–12 and 13–18 with cancer or blood disorders.

candidates.name: Bob Jones University
candidates.note: EDUcamp offers academic, arts and sports camps; overnight accommodation is available for grades 9–12.

candidates.name: Furman University
candidates.note: Youth summer programs include residential or commuter music camps and athletic camps; 2026 band and orchestra camp served ages 12–18.

candidates.name: Brandon Tucker Soccer Academy
candidates.note: Residential and commuter soccer camp at Furman for boys and girls ages 9–17; ran July 20–23, 2026.

candidates.name: US Sports Camps
candidates.note: Nike tennis camps at Furman and day/overnight soccer camps at North Greenville University; NGU serves ages 9–17.

candidates.name: South Carolina Governor's School for the Arts and Humanities
candidates.note: Residential summer arts programs for South Carolina students, including creative writing, dance, drama, film, music and visual arts.

candidates.name: Lifeway — FUGE Camps
candidates.note: Centrifuge and MFuge residential camps for middle- and high-school church groups at North Greenville University ran in 2026.

candidates.name: Passport, Inc.
candidates.note: PASSPORTchoices residential church-group camps at Converse University for students completing grades 6–12; ran in summer 2026.

candidates.name: Rod Ray Tennis Camp
candidates.note: Day and overnight tennis camps at Wofford College; summer 2026 sessions and June 2027 sessions found.

candidates.name: Ralph Lundy Soccer Academy
candidates.note: Residential soccer camp at USC Upstate ran June 14–17, 2026, for boys and girls ages 8–12.

candidates.name: Brown Girls Read
candidates.note: Residential literacy, creativity and leadership weekend for girls ages 10+ at Wofford College ran June 26–28, 2026.
